_comment: Cross-language golden for the content-addressed request_hash = "0x"+hex(keccak256(DocHash)) of each inner PaymentRequest fixture. The Go conformance_test.go (ComputeRequestHash) and the TS conformance.test.ts (computeRequestHash) both assert their output equals these values; if both match this file, they match each other. request_hash is PURE CONTENT: it strips the inner PR's own proof entirely (consumes DocHash, not SigningInput) and every sender_auth.signed_messages[*].signature, under a FIXED secp256k1 suite — so it is independent of signature material AND of how the PR was signed. The -go-signed and -ts-signed fixtures of a given cryptosuite share content and therefore the SAME request_hash; the secp and ed25519 fixtures differ in content (request_id) and therefore differ. Regenerate per conformance/README.md.
